name: external-agent-orchestrator
description: Delegate read-only coding tasks from Codex to supported local external agents and continue them by explicit session ID.

interface.longDescription: Lets Codex detect supported local coding agents, send bounded read-only tasks, normalize their replies, and continue an exact provider session without relying on the most recent conversation.
